Compute a calibration curve over a grid of shape-parameter interventions

Source: R/calibration.curve.fun.R
calibration.curve.fun.Rd

Evaluates tmle.alpha.fun() on the z process across a grid of shape interventions alpha.grid, and the resulting effect on target for each, tracing out a calibration curve relating alpha to the target estimand.

Usage

calibration.curve.fun(
  initial.fit = NULL,
  a = NULL,
  alpha.grid = seq(0, 5, length = 10),
  browse = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  output.eic = FALSE,
  tau = 1.2,
  tau.z = tau,
  use.cores = 50,
  target = "outcome",
  z.name = "z",
  min.iter = 1,
  target.by.state = FALSE,
  block.size.z = NULL,
  block.size.target = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

initial.fit

initial fit object, as returned by prepare.initial().

a

optional intervention on the baseline treatment A0, passed on to tmle.alpha.fun().

alpha.grid

numeric vector of shape-parameter interventions to evaluate.

browse

logical; if TRUE, drop into browser().

verbose

logical; if TRUE, print progress.

output.eic

logical; if TRUE, include influence-function values in the output.

tau

follow-up horizon for the target process.

tau.z

follow-up horizon for the z process (defaults to tau).

use.cores

number of cores to use.

target

character; name of the outcome process the curve is computed for.

z.name

character; name of the process on which the shape intervention alpha acts.

min.iter

minimum number of TMLE update iterations.

target.by.state

logical; whether to compute clever covariates by state, passed on to tmle.alpha.fun().

block.size.z

optional block size used when evaluating the z process.

block.size.target

optional block size used when evaluating target.

...

additional arguments passed on to tmle.alpha.fun().

Value

A data.table with one row per value in alpha.grid, giving the corresponding TMLE estimate of the effect on target.
